what: A raw percussion synth after the Behringer EDGE / Moog DFAM: one voice with two oscillators, FM, sync, noise and a ladder filter, an 8-step sequencer with a pitch row and a velocity row, and a clock that runs up to x128 until the rhythm turns into a tone. Held keys jump the clock, pads, random rows, MIDI clock in.
author: swtdr34mz
